core_obligations: Reduce: it suffices to prove the map is an isomorphism after applying the pushforward along the base change, and applying that functor to the map in question yields the base change map for the derived internal hom (proof lines 2709-2717)
Unwind: rewriting the left and right sides as in the cited proof, and using the adjunction between tensor and internal hom, gives the desired comparison (proof lines 2718-2722)
proof_roadmap: It suffices to check that the map (equation-base-change) becomes an isomorphism after applying the pushforward phi'_*.
Applying phi'_* and using A' = A tensor^L_R R' turns it into the known base change map for the derived internal hom (More on Algebra, equation base-change-RHom).
Unwinding both sides as in the proof of the More on Algebra base change lemma, using the tensor-hom adjunction upgrade lemma, gives the asserted comparison.
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes when the base change map of the trivial duality section is an isomorphism, namely exactly when the corresponding base change map for the derived internal hom is (author lemma at source lines 2695-2706, label lemma-check-base-change-is-iso). The proof (source lines 2708-2723) reduces to testing the map after pushing forward along the base change, identifies the resulting map with the known base change map for the internal hom, and unwinds both sides through the tensor-hom adjunction as in the cited proof (proof lines 2718-2722). The reduction and the unwinding are the substance. H2.
